chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who married a slave girl, then had intercourse with her and caused ifda' to her. He said: "He is responsible for maintaining her as long as she remains alive."

key_terms.الْإِجْرَاءُ عَلَيْهَا: ongoing maintenance and provision for her
key_terms.فَأَفْضَاهَا: he caused ifda' to her, a severe genital injury
key_terms.مَا دَامَتْ حَيَّةً: for as long as she remains alive

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man causes ifda' to a slave girl he married?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a husband who causes ifda' to a slave girl he married. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that he must continue providing for her maintenance for as long as she lives.
